
## Install

1. Download `Ports-<version>.dmg` below, open it and drag **Ports** to **Applications**.
2. Try opening Ports. macOS will warn you, because this build isn't notarized by Apple yet.
3. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.

Ports then turns on Open at Login, and you can turn that off from the gear in the panel. It needs macOS 13 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. Check your download against the `.sha256` file with `shasum -a 256 -c`, or [build it from source](https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/ports#build-from-source).
